notes: Official game identity, developer, place ID, and universe ID were independently checked against live Roblox APIs.
Four gameplay or progression facts were approved from current official Roblox media; one boxed-reward presentation fact is medium confidence and must be phrased cautiously.
No unverified codes, value list, weapon catalog, rarity system, crate odds, currency details, upgrade system, rebirth system, or exact live UI sequence may enter the site.
Dynamic popularity statistics were checked for identity context but intentionally excluded from site content.
All approved source URLs were rechecked through the project-mandated system proxy and returned HTTP 200; see source-verification.json.
